races.paceDynamic: Lisnamult Lad and What Path are confirmed front runners who will engage early and set a genuine gallop over this stamina-sapping trip. With 19 runners spread across 3m½f at Punchestown, the pace will be testing from the outset as these two leaders dispute the running through the early stages. The sustained gallop they create will stretch the field and expose any stamina limitations, particularly given the deteriorating ground conditions from Good to Soft to yielding on the card. This honest pace strongly favours hold-up horses who can finish late and prominent runners with proven stamina reserves.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained pace suits closers
scenarios.trigger: If Lisnamult Lad and What Path maintain a strong gallop through the middle stages
scenarios.body: The testing pace will set up perfectly for hold-up performers to come from off the pace in the closing stages. Horses like The Goffer, Fountain House and Chemical Energy can capitalise with their finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front runners collapse late
scenarios.trigger: If the early leaders fade after setting too strong a pace
scenarios.body: Prominent runners tracking the pace can strike when the leaders weaken, benefiting from the strong gallop without doing the donkey work. Vanillier and Escaria Ten are perfectly positioned to exploit this scenario.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Lisnamult Lad controls tempo
scenarios.trigger: If Lisnamult Lad gets an easier lead than expected with What Path not pressuring
scenarios.body: The leader can dictate a more tactical pace and use his stamina reserves to kick clear in the straight. This plays to front runners who can control the race from the outset and have the class to win from the front.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy pace benefits experience
scenarios.trigger: If the large field creates interference and uneven pace through jumping errors
scenarios.body: Experienced campaigners who can adapt to changing circumstances will benefit from tactical flexibility. Veteran performers can pick their way through trouble and strike when others are compromised.

watchPoints.text: Lisnamult Lad and What Path must engage early - if either gets an uncontested lead the race dynamic completely changes
Chemical Energy needs to bounce back from his last poor run - any early signs of struggling suggest bigger issues
Fountain House carrying amateur rider but comes here in red-hot form with three recent wins
Vanillier returns after 52-day break but his Grand National form suggests he's tailor-made for this test
Several runners returning from long layoffs including Call The Tune (563 days) and Gentleman De Reve (160 days) - market support crucial

races.paceDynamic: Lord Lariat will lead unchallenged early with 9 prominent runners (Saint Davy, Intense Raffles, J'Arrive de L'Est, Uncle Pat, Union Station, Daily Present, Brucejack, Will Do, Brideswell Lad, Fishery Lane, Built By Ballymore) creating a wall behind him but no early pressure on the leader. This congestion will cause carnage approaching 3 out as traffic builds with limited racing room. The sustainable early gallop followed by late acceleration heavily favours the 11 hold-up horses who can avoid the prominent traffic and deliver their challenge late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent pack bunches badly turning for home creating traffic problems
scenarios.body: The 11 hold-up runners get clear runs while prominent horses are trapped and shuffled back. Clean jumping and positioning becomes crucial as stamina takes over in the final half-mile.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Battle Sustained
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent group maintains good order and avoids major traffic incidents
scenarios.body: The pace stays strong throughout allowing the classier prominent runners to battle it out up the straight. Saint Davy and Intense Raffles can use their higher ratings to dominate.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Lord Lariat Stays On
scenarios.trigger: If Lord Lariat's uncontested lead proves insurmountable and he doesn't fade
scenarios.body: The 11-year-old uses his front-running advantage to build an unassailable lead that the field cannot peg back. His poor recent form becomes irrelevant with perfect tactical positioning.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If Lord Lariat goes too slow and the prominent pack fails to take up the running
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where pure class and speed matter most regardless of running style. Higher-rated horses with recent form can capitalise on tactical chaos.

watchPoints.text: Watch for carnage in the prominent pack from 3 out as 9 horses fight for limited racing room with several inexperienced claiming jockeys
Monitor Lord Lariat's early pace setting as his recent poor form suggests he may not sustain his front-running advantage
Watch Jasmin De Grugy and Fortunate Man for clean passages from the rear as they represent the strongest hold-up threats
Keep eye on Paul Townend's positioning on Uncle Pat as his tactical nous could exploit the prominent congestion
Watch for Mark Walsh finding the right passage on Better Times Ahead who has the form and style to capitalise late

races.paceDynamic: High Class Hero will lead from the start with no genuine pace rival to challenge him early, creating a sustainable rhythm over this staying trip. Your Darling, Bill Baxter, and the prominent runners will track behind but won't apply serious pressure until late. With such a large field (23 runners) and minimal early pace, the race will develop into a sprint finish from the home turn as the hold-up horses flood through. This pace scenario strongly favours the hold-up horses and closers who can benefit from the modest early gallop and unleash their finishing kick.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Stampede
scenarios.trigger: If High Class Hero sets uncontested fractions and the field bunches approaching the straight
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows stamina horses with finishing speed to position perfectly for late challenges. Multiple hold-up horses will time their runs to perfection in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Victory
scenarios.trigger: If Your Darling or Bill Baxter move closer to High Class Hero mid-race and establish better position
scenarios.body: These experienced campaigners use tactical speed to avoid the traffic that will engulf the hold-up horses. Their race position allows them to quicken when it matters without relying on gaps.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Steals It
scenarios.trigger: If High Class Hero gets easy sectionals and the field hesitates to challenge until too late
scenarios.body: The Mullins runner builds an unassailable lead as connections behind misjudge the pace. By the time serious challenges emerge, High Class Hero has done enough damage.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is crawling and the race becomes a messy cavalry charge from the back
scenarios.body: The moderate early gallop turns into a lottery finish where positioning and luck matter more than ability. Any horse getting a clear run can capitalise.

watchPoints.text: High Class Hero must be monitored early - if he gets soft sectionals with big leads, he becomes very dangerous despite stamina doubts
Your Darling and Bill Baxter positioning crucial - if they track closer than usual, they can avoid the expected traffic problems
The Doyen Chief and Montregard need to be delivered with perfectly timed runs as any early moves will be fatal
Multiple Mullins runners suggests stable confidence somewhere - watch which of their four gets most aggressive riding
Headgear changes on Bill Baxter, Beachcomber and multiple others indicate trainers expect improved performances

races.paceDynamic: Jade De Grugy and Wodhooh are both confirmed front runners who will engage from flagfall, creating an honest gallop from the start. With only four runners, the pace won't be frantic but will be solid throughout the 2m4½f trip. Place De La Nation will track the leaders prominently while Ill Raise A Glass settles at the back of the small field. This even gallop with two pace-setters battling early strongly favours the prominent tracker who can capitalize on any weakening of the dueling leaders.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Dual Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Jade De Grugy and Wodhooh engage too keenly early and both weaken
scenarios.body: The sustained duel between the front two creates the perfect setup for Place De La Nation to strike late. Her prominent position allows her to pounce when the pace-setters falter in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Wodhooh Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Wodhooh can dictate terms and see off Jade De Grugy's challenge
scenarios.body: Her superior recent form (three straight wins) and excellent going record allows her to control the pace and kick clear. The strong gallop suits her proven stamina reserves over this trip.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Jade De Grugy Revival
scenarios.trigger: If Paul Townend can restrain her early and avoid a sustained battle
scenarios.body: The champion jockey times her run perfectly, using the pace but not getting drawn into a speed duel. Her class edge in Grade 1 company tells in the final furlong despite recent inconsistency.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Ill Raise A Glass Shock
scenarios.trigger: If the front three go too hard and set it up perfectly for the hold-up horse
scenarios.body: The outsider gets a dream trip at the back as the other three engage in tactical warfare. Her fresh run style and lighter weight allows her to pick up the pieces late.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Jade De Grugy and Wodhooh engage in a sustained speed battle from the first flight - both could weaken dramatically
Monitor Place De La Nation's positioning early - needs to be close enough to strike when the pace-setters tire
Observe Paul Townend's tactics on Jade De Grugy - his restraint or aggression will determine if she can use her class edge
Check Ill Raise A Glass jumping early - any errors will end her slim chances in this small field
Watch the pace after the third flight - if it's genuinely strong both front runners become vulnerable to the closers

This race shape strongly favours prominent trackers and hold-up horses who can quicken off a strong gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Gallop Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the multiple front-runners go too hard early and fade from 2f out

scenarios.trigger: If one front-runner gets an uncontested lead and dictates terms
scenarios.body: Proactif or Madness d'Elle could steal a march if others hesitate early and maintain enough for the finish. The lack of early pressure allows them to reserve energy for home.

scenarios.label: D

scenarios.trigger: If the multiple pace-setters surprisingly check each other early creating a dawdle
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where class and acceleration matter more than stamina. The highest-rated horses with tactical speed will dominate.

races.paceDynamic: Dani Donadoni is the sole confirmed front runner and will dictate a sustainable early gallop without pressure. Eight prominent runners including Storm Heart, Laurets d'Estruval, Jump Allen, Sony Bill, Kel Histoire, Fierce Handay, Thisistheway and One Big Boum create a traffic jam 2-3 out as they converge for position. The large field of hold-up horses including Hello Neighbour, Tripoli Flyer and Iberico Lord will be angling wide in the straight. This race shape strongly favours the front runner and early prominent horses who can secure clean jumping room before the cavalry charge arrives.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Dani Donadoni gets an uncontested lead and kicks clear approaching the last
scenarios.body: The mare gets first run on rivals who are still fighting for position behind her. Clean jumping and Anna McGuinness' 7lb claim make her very hard to peg back.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Traffic Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the eight prominent runners create a bottleneck turning for home
scenarios.body: Several fancied horses get hampered or squeezed for room, allowing a cleaner traveller to strike. The winner comes from those who secure early position or find a smooth passage.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold Up Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly run and the field stretches out early
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get the strong gallop they need and can use their class advantage late. Iberico Lord and Hello Neighbour have the highest ratings to take advantage.

scenarios.label: D

races.paceDynamic: Thewaybackhome appears the only natural front-runner in this 25-runner charity race, likely to set uncontested fractions with Touch The Moon, Oogum Boogum, Indulging and Smackwater Jack settling prominently behind. The large field creates potential for scrimmaging and interference in mid-pack, while the softer ground favors sustained galloping over sprint finishes. With one pace-setter and multiple hold-up horses carrying fading warnings, this race shape strongly favors prominent runners who can track the leader without getting caught in traffic.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Thewaybackhome dictates moderate fractions without early pressure from prominent runners.
scenarios.body: The leader gets an easy time of it while the hold-up brigade get trapped behind the large field, making their finishing kicks less effective on the yielding ground. Prominent trackers get first run at a tiring leader.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pressure Tactics
scenarios.trigger: If Touch The Moon or other prominent runners force stronger early pace with Thewaybackhome.
scenarios.body: The increased tempo stretches the field and creates opportunities for closers with stamina, particularly those without fading warnings who can sustain their runs. The pace collapse favors horses hitting the line strongly.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Favors Class
scenarios.trigger: If the large field creates significant interference and trouble in running for multiple contenders.
scenarios.body: Higher-rated horses with better jockeys navigate the mayhem more effectively, while lesser lights get shuffled back or hampered. Class tells when racing room becomes premium.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Benefits From Pace
scenarios.trigger: If both pace-setters and prominent runners over-race early, leaving the race open for a closer.
scenarios.body: A well-positioned hold-up horse without recent fading issues capitalizes on a true-run race where the early pace sets up perfectly. Tactical positioning trumps ratings.

watchPoints.text: Thewaybackhome may get uncontested lead but has shown fading tendencies in recent heavy ground runs
Traffic problems highly likely with 25 runners funneling into turn, watch for interference to hold-up horses
Touch The Moon and other prominent runners may lack pace pressure early, creating tactical opportunities
Multiple runners carry fading warnings including Pride Of Place and Jungle Cove who may weaken if prominent early
Ground has deteriorated from good-to-soft to yielding throughout the card, favoring stamina over speed
